purpose: Falsify, without further search, the one raw-return candidate selected by the frozen Generation 4 result.
claim_boundary: All development, validation, and recent observations have been seen. Passing this protocol can earn only RAW_RETURN_SHADOW_ONLY after authenticated source overlap; it cannot establish independent alpha, a balanced champion, future profitability, or permission for live capital.
no_search_boundary: The runner must obtain the candidate id from the hash-pinned Generation 4 output and must abort if it differs. No alternative candidate, parameter, cost, anchor, period, block length, seed, or comparator may be selected after results.

data_and_execution.data_source: Saved Generation 4 private panel and ledger only; no market fetch is permitted.
data_and_execution.signal_trade_return: close-t information -> close-t+1 execution -> first t+1-to-t+2 return
data_and_execution.standalone_boundaries: Each named slice starts in BIL and charges final risky liquidation at the stated one-way cost.

cost_gate: Candidate annualized log-growth edge versus SPY must remain strictly positive in both development and validation at every 5/10/25 bp cost. Recent is reported but cannot rank or rescue the candidate.
schedule_gate: At 5 bp, candidate annualized log-growth edge versus fixed-anchor SPY must remain strictly positive in both development and validation for every native candidate offset 0 through 20. Recent is descriptive only.

statistical_gate.gate: Validation DSR must be at least 0.95 and all six fixed-candidate familywise adjusted p-values must be at most 0.05. Development statistics may not be substituted or pooled.

static_growth_control.role: Separate explanatory control, excluded from the seven-candidate DSR and bootstrap family.
required_reporting: standalone development and validation return and risk comparison
static_growth_control.consistent_financial_beat_definition: Candidate log-growth edge must be strictly positive in development and validation, and for every 252/504/756 validation annual-origin family its median edge must be positive with at least 60% positive windows.
static_growth_control.claim_rule: If the consistent financial beat definition fails, alpha independent of static SPY/QQQ growth exposure must be explicitly rejected. Mechanical distinction is disclosure only and cannot satisfy or replace this financial claim test.

recent_veto: The already-consumed frozen veto must remain passed at the 5 bp discovery schedule: drawdown not below -20%, total return not below BIL, and drawdown not over five percentage points worse than SPY.

source_overlap.scope_reason: These are every symbol used by the fixed candidate, its SPY benchmark, and its BIL cash convention. The eight unused search-menu symbols are outside the fixed-candidate source gate.
